description: This file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawNodeStorage' that provides static methods for generating URLs to different directories related to application support, caches, and canvas snapshots within the app's sandbox directories.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the application support directory for the app, appending 'OpenClaw' as a subdirectory.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Generates a URL for the 'canvas' folder within the application support directory, keyed by a session string (defaults to 'main' if the sessionKey is empty after trimming).

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the caches directory for the app, appending 'OpenClaw' as a subdirectory.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Generates a URL within the caches directory for 'canvas-snapshots', keyed by a session string (defaults to 'main' if empty).
